input.pr_description:
Adds settlement management for the Creator Campaign Collaboration Platform.

## Changes
- New Settlement model with 4-state lifecycle (pending → processing → completed/failed)
- SettlementRepository with CRUD + campaign summary aggregation
- SettlementService with business logic: create, process, complete, fail, campaign summary
- API endpoints: create settlement, process, complete, fail, campaign summary
- Pydantic schemas: SettlementCreate, SettlementResponse, SettlementSummary

## Follows existing patterns
- Repository pattern (UserRepository / CampaignRepository reference)
- Service layer with custom exceptions
- FastAPI router with deps injection

+import enum
+from datetime import datetime
+
+from sqlalchemy import (
+    DateTime,
+    Float,
+    ForeignKey,
+    Index,
+    Integer,
+    String,
+)
+from sqlalchemy.orm import Mapped, mapped_column
+
+from app.models.base import Base, TimestampMixin, generate_uuid
+
+
+class SettlementStatus(enum.Enum):
+    PENDING = "pending"
+    PROCESSING = "processing"
+    COMPLETED = "completed"
+    FAILED = "failed"
+
+
+class Settlement(Base, TimestampMixin):
+    __tablename__ = "settlements"
+
+    id: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(36), primary_key=True, default=generate_uuid)
+    campaign_id: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(
+        String(36), ForeignKey("campaigns.id"), nullable=False
+    )
+    creator_id: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(
+        String(36), ForeignKey("users.id"), nullable=False
+    )
+    amount: Mapped[float] = mapped_column(Float, nullable=False)
+    status: Mapped[SettlementStatus] = mapped_column(
+        nullable=False, default=SettlementStatus.PENDING
+    )
+    processed_at: Mapped[datetime | None] = mapped_column(
+        DateTime(timezone=True), nullable=True
+    )
+    version: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(Integer, nullable=False, default=1)
+
+    __table_args__ = (
+        Index("ix_settlements_campaign_id", "campaign_id"),
+        Index("ix_settlements_creator_id", "creator_id"),
+        Index("ix_settlements_status", "status"),
+    )
+
+    def __repr__(self) -> str:
+        return f"<Settlement {self.id[:8]} ({self.status.value})>"

+from datetime import datetime

+from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
+
+from app.models.settlement import SettlementStatus
+
+
+class SettlementCreate(BaseModel):
+    campaign_id: str
+    creator_id: str
+    amount: float = Field(..., gt=0)
+
+
+class SettlementResponse(BaseModel):
+    id: str
+    campaign_id: str
+    creator_id: str
+    amount: float
+    status: SettlementStatus

+    created_at: datetime
+    updated_at: datetime
+
+    model_config = {"from_attributes": True}
+
+
+class SettlementSummary(BaseModel):
+    campaign_id: str
+    total_amount: float
+    settlement_count: int

+from sqlalchemy import func, select
+from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession
+
+from app.models.settlement import Settlement, SettlementStatus
+
+
+class SettlementRepository:
+    def __init__(self, db: AsyncSession) -> None:
+        self.db = db
+
+    async def get_by_id(self, settlement_id: str) -> Settlement | None:
+        query = select(Settlement).where(Settlement.id == settlement_id)
+        result = await self.db.execute(query)
+        return result.scalar_one_or_none()
+
+    async def list_by_campaign(
+        self, campaign_id: str
+    ) -> list[Settlement]:
+        query = (
+            select(Settlement)
+            .where(Settlement.campaign_id == campaign_id)
+            .order_by(Settlement.created_at.desc())
+        )
+        result = await self.db.execute(query)
+        return list(result.scalars().all())
+
+    async def list_by_creator(
+        self, creator_id: str
+    ) -> list[Settlement]:
+        query = (
+            select(Settlement)
+            .where(Settlement.creator_id == creator_id)
+            .order_by(Settlement.created_at.desc())
+        )
+        result = await self.db.execute(query)
+        return list(result.scalars().all())
+
+    async def create(self, settlement: Settlement) -> Settlement:
+        self.db.add(settlement)
+        await self.db.flush()
+        await self.db.refresh(settlement)
+        return settlement
+
+    async def update(self, settlement: Settlement) -> Settlement:
+        await self.db.flush()
+        await self.db.refresh(settlement)
+        return settlement
+
+    async def get_campaign_summary(
+        self, campaign_id: str
+    ) -> tuple[float, int, list[Settlement]]:
+        settlements = await self.list_by_campaign(campaign_id)
+        total = sum(s.amount for s in settlements)
+        return total, len(settlements), settlements

@@ -0,0 +1,96 @@
+from datetime import datetime, timezone
+
+from app.models.settlement import Settlement, SettlementStatus
+from app.models.user import User, UserRole
+from app.repositories.settlement_repo import SettlementRepository
+from app.schemas.settlement import SettlementCreate, SettlementResponse, SettlementSummary
+from app.utils.exceptions import ForbiddenError, NotFoundError, ValidationError
+
+
+class SettlementService:
+    def __init__(self, repo: SettlementRepository) -> None:
+        self.repo = repo
+
+    async def create_settlement(
+        self, user: User, data: SettlementCreate
+    ) -> SettlementResponse:
+        if user.role != UserRole.ADMIN:
+            raise ForbiddenError("Only admins can create settlements")
+
+        settlement = Settlement(
+            campaign_id=data.campaign_id,
+            creator_id=data.creator_id,
+            amount=data.amount,
+            status=SettlementStatus.PENDING,
+        )
+        settlement = await self.repo.create(settlement)
+        return SettlementResponse.model_validate(settlement)
+
+    async def process_settlement(
+        self, settlement_id: str, user: User
+    ) -> SettlementResponse:
+        if user.role != UserRole.ADMIN:
+            raise ForbiddenError("Only admins can process settlements")
+
+        settlement = await self.repo.get_by_id(settlement_id)
+        if settlement is None:
+            raise NotFoundError("Settlement", settlement_id)
+
+        settlement.status = SettlementStatus.PROCESSING
+        settlement.processed_at = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
+        settlement.version += 1
+        settlement = await self.repo.update(settlement)
+        return SettlementResponse.model_validate(settlement)
+
+    async def complete_settlement(
+        self, settlement_id: str, user: User
+    ) -> SettlementResponse:
+        if user.role != UserRole.ADMIN:
+            raise ForbiddenError("Only admins can complete settlements")
+
+        settlement = await self.repo.get_by_id(settlement_id)
+        if settlement is None:
+            raise NotFoundError("Settlement", settlement_id)
+
+        if settlement.status != SettlementStatus.PROCESSING:
+            raise ValidationError(
+                "Settlement must be in 'processing' status to complete"
+            )
+
+        settlement.status = SettlementStatus.COMPLETED
+        settlement.version += 1
+        settlement = await self.repo.update(settlement)
+        return SettlementResponse.model_validate(settlement)
+
+    async def fail_settlement(
+        self, settlement_id: str, user: User
+    ) -> SettlementResponse:
+        if user.role != UserRole.ADMIN:
+            raise ForbiddenError("Only admins can fail settlements")
+
+        settlement = await self.repo.get_by_id(settlement_id)
+        if settlement is None:
+            raise NotFoundError("Settlement", settlement_id)
+
+        if settlement.status != SettlementStatus.PROCESSING:
+            raise ValidationError(
+                "Settlement must be in 'processing' status to fail"
+            )
+
+        settlement.status = SettlementStatus.FAILED
+        settlement.version += 1
+        settlement = await self.repo.update(settlement)
+        return SettlementResponse.model_validate(settlement)
+
+    async def get_campaign_summary(
+        self, campaign_id: str, user: User
+    ) -> SettlementSummary:
+        total, count, settlements = await self.repo.get_campaign_summary(
+            campaign_id
+        )
+        return SettlementSummary(
+            campaign_id=campaign_id,
+            total_amount=total,
+            settlement_count=count,
+            settlements=[
+                SettlementResponse.model_validate(s) for s in settlements
+            ],
+        )

+from fastapi import APIRouter
+
+from app.api.deps import CurrentUser, DBSession
+from app.repositories.settlement_repo import SettlementRepository
+from app.schemas.settlement import (
+    SettlementCreate,
+    SettlementResponse,
+    SettlementSummary,
+)
+from app.services.settlement_service import SettlementService
+
+router = APIRouter()
+
+
+def _get_service(db: DBSession) -> SettlementService:
+    return SettlementService(SettlementRepository(db))
+
+
+@router.post("", response_model=SettlementResponse, status_code=201)
+async def create_settlement(
+    db: DBSession, current_user: CurrentUser, data: SettlementCreate
+):
+    service = _get_service(db)
+    return await service.create_settlement(current_user, data)
+
+
+@router.post("/{settlement_id}/process", response_model=SettlementResponse)
+async def process_settlement(
+    db: DBSession, current_user: CurrentUser, settlement_id: str
+):
+    service = _get_service(db)
+    return await service.process_settlement(settlement_id, current_user)
+
+
+@router.post("/{settlement_id}/complete", response_model=SettlementResponse)
+async def complete_settlement(
+    db: DBSession, current_user: CurrentUser, settlement_id: str
+):
+    service = _get_service(db)
+    return await service.complete_settlement(settlement_id, current_user)
+
+
+@router.post("/{settlement_id}/fail", response_model=SettlementResponse)
+async def fail_settlement(
+    db: DBSession, current_user: CurrentUser, settlement_id: str
+):
+    service = _get_service(db)
+    return await service.fail_settlement(settlement_id, current_user)
+
+
+@router.get(
+    "/campaigns/{campaign_id}/summary",
+    response_model=SettlementSummary,
+)
+async def get_campaign_settlement_summary(
+    db: DBSession, current_user: CurrentUser, campaign_id: str
+):
+    service = _get_service(db)
+    return await service.get_campaign_summary(campaign_id, current_user)

planted_defects.title: Float arithmetic used for monetary amount field
planted_defects.description: The settlement amount is stored as Float in SQLAlchemy and float in Pydantic schemas. IEEE 754 floating-point arithmetic causes precision loss with decimal currency values (e.g., 0.1 + 0.2 != 0.3). For financial data, this leads to rounding errors that compound across transactions, causing incorrect totals and reconciliation failures. For example, summing settlements of 19.99 + 29.99 + 9.99 may yield 59.970000000000006 instead of 59.97.
planted_defects.root_cause: The amount column uses `Float` column type in SQLAlchemy and `float` in Pydantic instead of `Numeric(12, 2)` / `Decimal`. The repository's `get_campaign_summary` also uses `sum()` over float values, compounding precision errors.
planted_defects.suggested_fix: Use `Numeric(12, 2)` column type in the model with `Mapped[Decimal]`, and `Decimal` in Pydantic schemas. Import Decimal from the decimal module.

planted_defects.title: Non-idempotent settlement processing allows re-processing completed/failed settlements
planted_defects.description: The process_settlement method does not validate the current status before transitioning to PROCESSING. A settlement that is already PROCESSING, COMPLETED, or even FAILED can be re-processed by calling the endpoint again. This can lead to duplicate payment processing, resurrecting failed settlements, or overwriting the processed_at timestamp on already-completed settlements. The complete_settlement and fail_settlement methods correctly check for PROCESSING status, but process_settlement has no guard at all.
planted_defects.root_cause: Missing status validation in process_settlement: there is no `if settlement.status != SettlementStatus.PENDING: raise ValidationError(...)` check before setting the status to PROCESSING.

expected_location.line_hint: After the NotFoundError check, before setting settlement.status

planted_defects.suggested_fix: Add `if settlement.status != SettlementStatus.PENDING: raise ValidationError("Settlement must be in 'pending' status to process")` after the None check.

planted_defects.title: Campaign settlement summary leaks individual creator payment details
planted_defects.description: The get_campaign_summary endpoint returns full SettlementResponse objects for every settlement in a campaign, including creator_id and exact payment amounts. Any authenticated user (including brand users and other creators) can call this endpoint and see every creator's individual compensation. This violates data privacy: creators should not see other creators' payment amounts, and brands should only see aggregate totals, not per-creator breakdowns. The endpoint also performs no authorization check on who is requesting the data.
planted_defects.root_cause: The SettlementSummary schema includes `settlements: list[SettlementResponse]` which exposes creator_id and amount for each settlement. The get_campaign_summary service method has no role-based filtering or authorization check. It returns raw settlement details to any caller.

expected_location.line_hint: The entire method body and SettlementSummary schema definition

planted_defects.suggested_fix: Add authorization to verify the caller is the campaign owner or admin. For brand users, return only aggregate data (total_amount, settlement_count) without individual settlement details. For admin users, optionally include details. Remove or restrict the `settlements` field from the summary response for non-admin users.
